messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU capacity saturation detected in project projects-prod (region: us-central1). Autoscaler is failing to attach GPUs; scale-up stalled. Affected pool: inference-centralus-v2. Queue growth +95% over 10m.

Taylor: I'm on it, taking the pager. Will check autoscaler + attach logs.

Jamie: I see repeated attach_denied + quota errors in node-manager. GCP quota API shows limits reached for GPUs in us-central1. Link to logs: https://redwood/logs/incident/6789012345

Taylor: paste the failing command/output if you have it.

Jamie:```
gcloud compute instances create example-node --zone=us-central1-a --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1
ERROR: (gcloud) Quota 'CPUS' exceeded. Available: 0
```
Also from agent:```
attach_error: attach failed: QUOTA_EXCEEDED: 'gpu-count' limit 200 reached for project projects-prod in region us-central1
```

Maria: Customer impact: hosted inference requests for several customers are queuing and timing out. Dashboard: request queue ~43k, p50 inference latency up from 3s to 24s for queued requests. Some 502 spikes reported in the last 8m.

Sre-eli: Can we route allocations to a fallback pool in another region (us-east1) or spin CPU-only fallback for non-latency-critical traffic?

Taylor: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause new allocations to the saturated pool; 2) route new allocation attempts to fallback pool in us-east1; 3) open quota ticket with GCP and escalate. I'll start 1 & 2 now.

Jamie: Executing mutation to pause pool:```
POST /api/internal/pools/inference-centralus-v2/actions
{"action":"set_desired","value":0}
```
Status: 200 OK — desired set to 0. :white_check_mark:

Cloudops: Updating routing policy to prefer fallback pool (us-east1). Propagation expected ~60-90s.

Product-support-bot: Notifying impacted customers in Slack & creating support tickets for top-N affected accounts. Template queued.

Maria: Note — fallback pool has cold starts, expect ~2-3m ramp and higher cost per token while quantized model warmups happen. Monitoring token spend.

Sre-eli: Short-term alternative: enable cross-region fallback on autoscaler (allow_cross_region_fallback=true) so new nodes can be allocated in us-east1 automatically. That reduces manual routing.

Taylor: Applying config patch to control plane now:```
kubectl -n controlplane apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  allow_cross_region_fallback: "true"
EOF
```
Patch applied. :hammer_and_wrench:

Jamie: Opened GCP support case 0123456789 (Quota increase request). Set severity P2 and looped in account manager.

Cloudops: Routing change shows effect — allocation attempts now hitting fallback pool. Queue is decreasing steadily. Current queue trend: 43k -> 28k over 12m. No new attach_denied spikes.

Maria: Customer comms sent to top 5 affected customers. Acme Analytics reported intermittent timeouts, CS is engaged and sharing workaround (retry/backoff).

Sre-eli: Post-mortem action items: (a) request permanent quota increase for us-central1 GPUs, (b) add opportunistic prewarm instances in fallback region, (c) adjust fair-share to reduce single-tenant footprint, (d) investigate pool fragmentation causing wasteful per-request allocs.

Taylor: Assigning follow-ups: Jamie -> keep GCP ticket & logs updated; Cloudops -> validate fallback capacity & finalize routing policy; Maria -> customer comms and SLA impact summary; Sre-eli -> cost estimate & prewarm runbook. I'll leave a handoff note for night shift in 2h.

Product-support-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff checklist https://redwood/handbook/oncall-handoff (please fill incident summary).

Taylor: Current status: mitigated (traffic routed to fallback), partial customer impact persists, recovery progressing. Handoff to @sre-eli for overnight watch.

Sre-eli: Ack. I'll monitor provider ticket updates and queue metrics. Ping me if GCP responds or if latency spikes again. :thumbsup:

Maria: Adding SLA impact to incident board and flagging for postmortem.

Jamie: Saving key logs & commands to incident doc: https://redwood/incidents/6789012345/doc

Taylor: Thanks team. Will update incident board with timeline and actions.

incident-bot: Incident state changed -> MONITORED (mitigation applied).
